'''Rod Latham Dark Deal''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Rod Latham]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/bb1.htm Dark Deal], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20031210164052/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/bb1.htm Internet Archive]</ref>

* '''Player:''' [[Rod Latham]]

* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
